latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Secure Deployment Pipeline skill  
- Provides a structured assessment and hardening guide for CI/CD pipeline supply chain security.
- Maps pipeline threats to mitigations using a three-adversary model (benign insiders, malicious insiders, external attackers).
- Generates binary provenance requirements and defines provenance-based deployment policies with choke-point enforcement.
- Recommends verifiable build architectures and produces a staged hardening roadmap, including auditable breakglass controls.
- Requires secure-code-review as a prerequisite for foundational supply-chain security.
